item_short_desc: Rothco Stainless Steel Handcuffs provide durable restraint with a sturdy 2.5mm stainless steel frame and double lock mechanism. Each pair comes with 2 standard police cuff keys, ideal for law enforcement and public safety professionals. These handcuffs are reliable tools for restraining individuals securely. Additionally, please note that this item is restricted for export and may not be sold for use in some countries outside the U.S. For further information, please contact Rothco.
